item.title: Iran war live: Tehran warns of ‘decisive’ response to any US ‘aggression’
item.description: Iran's Araghchi issues warning in separate phone calls with the foreign ministers of Turkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Singapore bans UK band Massive Attack over Palestinian flag

item.title: New York Times reveals Trump administration subpoena over North Korea story
item.description: The Justice Department faces criticism for increasing use of subpoenas in attempts to compel journalists to reveal info.

item.title: Growing like ‘gangbusters’: Can Taiwan maintain its economic momentum?
item.description: Taiwan's GDP is soaring on back of US imports of AI chips, but experts warn that problems could arise with Trump, China.

item.title: Michigan joins Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks, with FBI investigating
item.description: No culprit has been identified in any of the attacks, which comes after authorities warned of possible Iranian plot.

item.description: Spain says “virtually all” of the estimated 60,000 migrants who stormed its North African enclave of Ceuta have left.

item.title: Police say 13 killed as small plane viewing Nazca Lines in Peru crashes
item.description: Those killed included 11 passengers and two pilots flying over the famous archeological site, recognised by UNESCO.

item.description: Clashes near Sheraro mark one of the most serious threats yet to the fragile 2022 Pretoria peace deal.

item.description: Settler violence escalates, with illegal outposts and frequent attacks reported across Ramallah, Hebron and Nablus.

item.title: Three die in Moscow restaurant bombing

item.title: Moroccan rapper Mehdi El Youbi temporarily released from prison

item.title: Israeli strikes kill seven across Gaza, destroy medical supply warehouse

item.title: At least 11 wounded by Colombia car bomb days before presidential election
item.description: President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella pledges to pursue harsh crackdown on rebel groups and criminal organisations.

item.title: Two ex-Sri Lanka officials sentenced to death over 2019 Easter bombings
